description: The DOM is the browser's model of a page. JavaScript can use it to find a part, change words or react to a click. Learn with small pages that each do one clear job. The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.
versionNote: Uses standard DOM APIs in current browsers; no framework or account is needed.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to replace Mia with a different name
Learn to change the reply to a greeting for your club
Learn to add another data-book button inside the list
